executionRulings: Ruling: continue the authorized inline investigation in the current branch with the already frozen product build — the user accepted the next W26 tail priority and the preceding stage verified this exact source tree — cost if wrong: diagnostic time; no product change without an isolated cause and separate acceptance tests.

Ruling: use600frame windows with the old helper's complete-turn/two-unit trajectory — longer windows improve tail sampling while preserving the matched spatial path across new windows — cost if wrong: angular motion is five times slower than the old120frame series,so old/new percentile differences are not a speedup comparison.

Ruling: repair the external measurement scheduler before drawing application-tail conclusions — actual Three reproduction proves the old stop/restart sequence leaves an orphan RAF chain — cost if wrong: another set of native runs; previous cadence/tail claims require qualification and no speculative production fix is justified.
